name: Default
shortDescription: Web front-end for the rTorrent BitTorrent client, bundled with rTorrent behind HTTP basic auth, with persistent session, settings and downloads.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated password stored after {PLAIN} in the rutorrent.htpasswd mount. Edit that mount to change the login, then redeploy.
The BitTorrent peer ports are not published, so rTorrent can only reach peers through outgoing connections.
